edit.description: The emit pass carries its harness-relative paths as raw `PathBuf`/`String` and re-spells them at each reader. Type `Projection::source_path` (978) `HarnessRelativePath`, spelled once where the projection is pushed (1778-1786) off `member_projection_path`'s `PathBuf` (1646). Then: `layout_paths` (1551), `local_paths` (1555) and `owned_paths` (1822) become `BTreeSet<HarnessRelativePath>`, dropping the hand spells at 1681, 1714, 1824 and 1834; the `manifests` map (1563) and the `cached_manifest_raws` it is walked beside (1923) key by the same type — coupled, not separable, because 1687 looks a member's own projection path up in that map — reaching `manifest_segment_reaps` (2328) and `emit_manifest`'s `locus` (2216); `PriorEmitHashes` (2277) keys by the type, so `write_outcome` (2291) loses its per-member `to_canonical_spelling` (2299) and the map build at 1857 loses its `.to_string()`; the two `RollupEntry` wraps (1941, 1970) become plain clones. `emit_one`'s root join (3035) and `is_markdown_path` (3076) read through the type's `AsRef<Path>`. `EmitEntry::source_path` (894) stays a `PathBuf`: it carries the root-joined disk path (3035), not the harness-relative one.

`HarnessRelativePath`'s carrier list (138-142) — restated by the parent entry to name `Projection` as the one name its closing claim ("a path fact's root is its type, not its doc comment") did not yet cover. This entry covers it: drop the exception, leaving the list true of every name on it.

summary: Emit's own projection and manifest paths are raw `PathBuf` keys re-spelled at every reader — including once per member inside the emit loop.

per.section: A shared concept is one type

tests.asserts: emit outcomes, the reap diff and the overwrite classification are unchanged over typed projection paths
a represented manifest still emits whole and its container's rollup row carries the same `source_path` spelling
the committed lock's row spellings do not move

acceptance: `cargo test` green with no snapshot moves, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean, and `rg 'to_canonical_spelling' src/drift.rs` left with no call over a projection path or a manifest locus.
notes: Second half of the carrier census the parent entry opens; serialized behind it because both edit src/drift.rs. Behavior-neutral, so the pin is compile-time — except `write_outcome`'s spell, which ran once per member inside the emit loop and is a tree-scale cost the type deletes. ~30 call sites, one file plus the doc: if that proves oversized, the `manifests`-key half is the split, though 1687 couples it. scoped at 7e9a5a03
